$comment: The reviewed SHA-1 fingerprints of the CA certificates the E2E issuer's host serves in its TLS chain. ONE copy, read by infra/alibaba-e2e (the RAM OIDC provider's fingerprint set, max 5) and by scripts/ci/check-e2e-issuer-health.mjs (the scheduled check that the live chain is still covered). Populate or extend it ONLY with `node scripts/ci/check-e2e-issuer-health.mjs --print-pin --expected-url <url> --out infra/e2e-issuer/tls-ca-pin.json` (never a `>` redirect, which empties this file before it is read), which reads the VERIFIED live chain and merges atomically, and commit it in a reviewed PR. Empty = not yet observed: alibaba-e2e refuses to plan the broker trust and the health check reports the pin as missing. See infra/e2e-issuer/README.md.
